sentences.text: 1. The respondent stands discharged in the charge-sheet arising out of FIR No. 145/2023 registered with Police Station, Domana for commission of offences under Sections 354-B, 376, 511 of IPC and Sections 4, 8, 18 of POCSO Act.
2. The petitioner has assailed the order dated 16.06.2023 by virtue of which the respondent was granted interim bail by the learned Special Judge, Fast Track Court, POCSO Cases, Jammu.

entities.text: Fast Track Court, POCSO Cases, Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. In view of discharge of the accused in the main chargesheet arising out of FIR No. 145/2023 registered with Police Station, Domana for commission of offences under Sections 354-B, 376, 511 of IPC and Sections 4, 8, 18 of POCSO Act, the present petition has been rendered infructuous.
4. Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
